# graphiant_alert_records (Data Source)

Current top-level (parent) alert records. Child alerts, acknowledgement fields, and a caller-supplied historical time window are not yet exposed — this always reads the API's default (unfiltered) current alert list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_alert_records" "current" {}

output "critical_alert_count" {
  value = length([for a in data.graphiant_alert_records.current.alerts : a if a.severity == "critical"])
}
```
